source.title: Sdílená data o zeleni - vegetační prvky - body

selection: kod_vp 71 (Strom) within 300 m of the PID shape
fields: measuredHeight (DSM 2025 crown top minus lidar terrain; null if no crown)
limitations: The shared greenery data covers trees managed by the city districts; private gardens are incomplete.
Height, crown size and species are not published and are estimated in the scene.

surfaceMeasurement.title: IPR Praha, Digitální model povrchu – 1m (DSM 2025)
surfaceMeasurement.treeHeight: Highest surface within 2.5 m of the mapped position minus bare-earth terrain; 3–40 m accepted.
surfaceMeasurement.detection: Crown peaks >= 4 m within 200 m of the line, highest in a 7 m window, a 3 m ring at least 0.7 m lower on average and 0.25 m lower everywhere (inside mapped woodland 0.3 m on average), outside buildings (+1.5 m), water and bridges, at least 3.5 m from mapped trees and 3 m from each other.
surfaceMeasurement.vegetationCheck: Detected crowns need a median NDVI >= 0.15 around the peak in the IPR colour-infrared orthophoto (2024).
